headline: Hedge Fund Manager Indicted for Trading $1.2 Million on Confidential Merger Data via Kalshi
summary: A hedge fund executive has been charged with using nonpublic merger talks to make about $1.2 million in trades on Kalshi prediction markets. Marcus T. Reilly, 51, allegedly used confidential information about a pending acquisition to place 47 successful wagers ahead of the deal announcement.
key_points: Reilly allegedly profited approximately $1.2 million through 47 wagers on Kalshi over six weeks
Charges include securities fraud, insider trading, and wire fraud
Reilly received the nonpublic merger information in his role as a fund advisor
The SEC has filed a parallel civil complaint seeking $87,000 in disgorgement of related fees

source_documents.title: SEC v. Marcus T. Reilly: Civil Complaint for Securities Fraud and Insider Trading
